title: Norseen report under NASA weather contract N66001
place_text: Navy SPAWAR Systems Center, San Diego

tellings.quote: According to Norseen citation, that report was funded under the contract N66001. [music]

plain: Michels says that a 2000 report by the researcher John Norseen, titled "Biofusion Reflexive Control and Neuro-ergonomic Integration in Adaptive Cockpits", was funded under a contract numbered N66001, according to Norseen's own citation. The story places the work at a Navy research center in San Diego and ties the contract to NASA weather work. Michels brings it up in an episode about a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor, as a sign of where such research money quietly went.
